projectName: StaffTime — Workforce OS for Shopify POS
notes: MVP core built and deployed (stafftime-3) to spaceraceplayground.myshopify.com.
Dev config split: shopify.app.toml (deploy/webhooks) + shopify.app.local.toml (localhost dev without webhooks).
Fixed: POS timer server sync, dashboard auto-refresh every 10s, open entry query, shop domain normalization.
Fixed: unique PIN enforcement — duplicate PINs blocked in Admin and rejected on POS.
POS tile must be manually added to Smart Grid in Settings → Point of sale.
ST028 complete: POS workflow integration tests (6), Android QA checklist, dev:pos script for ngrok.
ST032 complete: Staff add form expanded to match competitor staff profile flow with payroll, availability, and payment method fields.
Fixed: payment method detail fields now render conditionally based on selected method.
Fixed: employee form fields wrap cleanly; payroll type is hourly, weekly, or monthly with one matching amount field.
Renamed admin Employees route to Staff at /app/staff.
ST033 complete: /app/staff now shows Staff Management and Add Shopify Staff opens /app/staff/new.
ST034 complete: new Shopify staff remain inactive until first successful POS login, then firstLoginAt is recorded.
Updated: Staff Management table actions use Lucide icons instead of text controls.
ST026 complete: Staff edit route supports profile updates and optional PIN changes with uniqueness enforcement.
Updated: Staff edit form now has the same random PIN generator as add staff.
Updated: Staff add/edit forms now use Shopify save/discard via data-save-bar; added a Cursor rule for future route forms.
Cleaned up /app/staff/new so it only renders the add staff form, not the staff list.
ST035 complete: inactive staff badge shows info tooltip on Staff Management table.
ST036 complete: fixed embedded navigation — Add Shopify Staff uses Polaris s-button href; internal links use React Router Link.
ST037 complete: staff detail page at /app/staff/:id with Overview and Payroll tabs (Commission tab empty).
ST038 complete: Lucide star on Current Plan card; staff names link to detail page.
ST039 complete: task-tracking Cursor rule for keeping task JSON in sync after updates.
ST040 complete: staff list search, status tabs, select-all, and row selection on Staff Management.
ST041 complete: bulk Archive all and Delete all for selected staff; ARCHIVED status added to schema.
T016 marked complete — all MVP hardening subtasks (ST021–ST028) done.
Next priorities: missed punch create form, production hosting, QR display, App Store prep.
Competitive reference: Zon Staff Management on Shopify App Store.

nextUp.title: Display employee QR codes in Admin
